notes: Family generated first as style reference. Nine individual sheets generated from that reference, then family corrected against the snail, beetle and bellflower sheets. Four expressions per individual sheet: happy, singing, sleepy, thirsty. Opaque cream backgrounds; reference illustrations, not cutout sprites. Palette hex values are prompt targets, not exact color-managed output guarantees.

assets.prompt:
